{{Combat}} [[Tower of Ilgalar]] | affiliation = [[Stormwind (kingdom)|Kingdom of Stormwind]], [[Blackrock clan]], [[Redridge pack]] }} The '''Redridge Mountains''' (also known as the '''Red Ridge Mountains''',[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Red_Ridge_Mountains_(WC1_Orc) The Red Ridge Mountains (WC1 Orc)][[A Torn Journal]] or the '''Redridge Range'''''[[The Last Guardian]]'', pg. 1''Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos'' manual, pg. 82) are located east of [[Elwynn Forest]], northeast of [[Duskwood]], and south of the [[Burning Steppes]]. Although it may be considered [[contested]], [[Horde]] characters have no settlements or NPCs, and it is thus a place they use mostly for passing through to reach [[Flame Crest]] or [[Stonard]]. An idyllic region of rushing rivers, towering elms, and rising elevations, the Redridge Mountains are under the protection of the [[Stormwind (kingdom)|kingdom of Stormwind]]. On the western bank of [[Lake Everstill]] is the [[Alliance]] town of [[Lakeshire]], the central hub for this faction's [[adventurer]]s, offering many services and quests, as well as [[flight path]]s. The crossroads known as the [[Three Corners]], located in the southwest corner of the zone, connects the town of Lakeshire with Elwynn, Duskwood and, via the Lakeridge Highway, [[Stonewatch Keep]]. The highway itself is quite a dangerous place occupied by [[gnolls]], [[murloc]]s, and wild animals. A force of [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock]] [[orc]]s from the Burning Steppes has secured Stonewatch Keep for the [[Dark Horde]], and are also in control of the northern roads. There are also a few camps located in Redridge — an orc camp in [[Render's Valley]], [[Shadowhide clan|Shadowhide]] [[gnoll]] camps near the [[Tower of Ilgalar]], and murloc camps near the lake. While the lake's surface appears peaceful enough, murlocs reside beneath the waves, and rumors of sightings of a sea monster persist. In comparison with [[Westfall]], Redridge is still relatively stable. ==Geography== The Redridge Mountains contain no dungeons, raid dungeons, or battlegrounds. The micro dungeon [[Stonewatch]] can be found in this zone. The Redridge Range stretches from the zone of the Redridge Mountains to the zone of [[Deadwind Pass]]. ===Redridge Range=== The '''Redridge Range'''''[[The Last Guardian]]'', pg. 2 is a mountain range in the southern sub-continent of [[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth]]. It reaches from the [[Deadwind Pass]] in the south to what's now called the [[Searing Gorge]] in the north. Two hundred years before the opening of the [[Dark Portal]], the northern reaches of the range were obliterated by the summoning of [[Ragnaros|Firelord Ragnaros]] and the creation of [[Blackrock Mountain]]. === Maps and subregions === [[File:WorldMap-Redridge.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Redridge Mountains.]] {{clrl}} {| class="fandom-table" |- || [[Alther's Mill]] • [[Galardell Valley]] • [[Lake Everstill]] • [[Lakeridge Highway]] • [[Lakeshire]] ([[Lakeshire Inn]] • [[Lakeshire Town Hall]]) • [[Redridge Canyons]] • [[Redwall Keep]] • [[Render's Camp]] ([[Render's Rock]]) • [[Render's Valley]] • [[Rethban Caverns]] • [[Stonewatch]] ([[Stonewatch Keep]] • [[Stonewatch Tower]]) • [[Stonewatch Falls]] • [[Three Corners]] • [[Tower of Ilgalar]] |- |} {{clrl}} === Travel hubs === ===={{Alliance}} [[Flight path]]s from [[Lakeshire]]==== * [[Stormwind City]], [[Elwynn Forest]] * [[Sentinel Hill]], [[Westfall]] * [[Darkshire]], [[Duskwood]] * [[Morgan's Vigil]], [[Burning Steppes]] ===Adjacent regions=== {| class="fandom-table" |- !
